title: santa bag with glued eyes
text:
santa bag with glued eyes. This bag arrived with one eyeball off and the other dangling off. They were attached by glue. The bag itself was ok.. fairly thick... just a shame that it was so junky looking with glued on eyes. I couldn't use it for what I had planned. Honestly, I just tossed in the trash. I was in the midst of crazy xmas season, or I would have returned it. I would not buy this again.
UPDATE 2/8/2017..... Almost two months after my purchase, I was contacted by the seller today to offer me a replacement or refund. I accepted the refund. Per their request, I have added this information to my review.
